Syllabus - topics in the 2022 paper

Our archive does not have the official syllabus for this post. The 2022 paper (25 September 2022, 100 questions) shows what the board tested, roughly in this order:

BlockApprox. questionsTopics seen
English10sentence improvement, synonyms, antonyms, one-word substitution, voice, analogy, idioms, narration
Punjabi10grammar, word meanings and usage
Computers (ICT)10types of computers, browsers, IP address, email (CC/BCC), Word, Excel functions, PowerPoint shortcuts
Punjab history and culture10capital before 1947, Punjabi novels and poets (Waris Shah), Nanakshahi coins, Doaba districts, folk singers, Punjab Kesari, Greek names of rivers, freedom fighters
Child development, nutrition and ICDS20child development stages, emotional and social development, inclusive education, family welfare, Integrated Child Protection Scheme, newborn feeding, protein-energy malnutrition, vitamins, Mission Indradhanush, duties of Anganwadi workers and helpers
GK and current affairs15sports, national film awards, NITI Aayog indices, new laws, international days, Booker Prize, science principles, Constitution
Quantitative aptitude15number system, HCF and LCM, ratio, mensuration
Reasoning10series, analogy, odd one out, coding-decoding, blood relations, directions, symbols, non-verbal figures

The question counts are our estimate from the paper. Child development and nutrition is the one block only this post asks - give it the most time.
